language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. Changes apply immediately.
language.saveFailed: Language changed for this session, but the preference could not be saved.

permissions.installExplanation: This requires administrator access (one password prompt) to install an application-owned udev rule to /etc/udev/rules.d/69-glacier-eq.rules and reload udev. It installs no background services; a distribution package rule is left untouched.
permissions.removeExplanation: This deletes {{path}}. You may need root permissions to access your DAC over USB until rules are reinstalled.
permissions.title: Linux USB permissions
permissions.manualHelp: On Linux, run this command in a terminal to install the rule manually, then reconnect the DAC:
permissions.installedConnect: Permissions installed. Connect the DAC to enable automatic connection.
permissions.packageManagedHelp: USB permissions are managed by the installed system package; remove the package to revoke them.
permissions.description: Linux restricts raw USB access by default. Installing a udev rule lets you access supported DACs without running Glacier EQ as root.

general.autoReadDescription: Read EQ automatically when a DAC connects
general.verifyDescription: Read back the EQ settings to check they were applied correctly. Required safety checks always run.
general.liveApplyDescription: Apply each EQ edit to the DAC as you make it and save it once you pause, so there is no Write to DAC step. Saving rewrites the DAC's flash after each pause.
general.liveApplyUnavailable: Hear EQ edits on the DAC as you make them. Needs a connected DAC that supports it (EPZ TP35 Pro).
general.snapFrequencyDescription: Snap frequency sliders and handles to standard 1/3-octave ISO steps
general.floatingGraphDescription: Show a small graph preview when scrolling past filter bands
general.showGraphDescription: Show the frequency response graph above controls

savedAutomatically: Settings are saved automatically on this device.

appearance.graphModeDescription: Shape normalizes curves at 1 kHz. Level shows absolute dB output.

diagnostics.logDescription: View USB traffic, connection events, and driver logs

about.title: About Glacier EQ
about.description: Parametric equalizer and hardware DSP controller for USB DACs.
about.howItWorks: Glacier EQ communicates directly with supported USB DACs over HID. Parametric EQ settings are saved into device flash memory with no background battery drain.

persistence.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Your changes may be lost when you restart: {{error}}
persistence.loadFailed: Could not load settings. Changes will not be saved until loading succeeds: {{error}}

updates.restartExplanation: Glacier EQ will close and reopen on version {{version}}. Write or save any open EQ changes first, because unsaved edits are lost.

unsupported.systemPackage: This copy was installed from a system package (.deb or .rpm). Update it with your package manager.
unsupported.mobile: Android updates come as a new APK. Install the latest release from GitHub.
unsupported.unpackaged: This copy can't update itself (portable, development, or distribution-built). Download a newer release instead.

updates.ready: Version {{version}} is downloaded and ready to install.
updates.title: Software updates
updates.privacy: Glacier EQ checks GitHub releases once at launch. Downloads are verified against Glacier EQ's signing key before they install.
updates.availableToast: Glacier EQ {{version}} is available. Open Settings > About to update.
